evidence_items.explanation: Controlled video-learning experiments support the narrower claim that physical generalization remained unreliable. The same result reports successful learning within the training distribution, limiting any inference that sensory learning simply fails.

evidence_items.locator: Introduction, Overview of Sora, paragraph about recaptioning
evidence_items.explanation: Sora's documented training uses generated language alongside visual data. Its failures therefore do not constitute a clean test of learning exclusively from sensory inputs, although they remain relevant to learning without explicit physical rules.

unresolved_gaps: The evidence does not isolate sensory learning itself as the reason for the observed failures.
Sora's documented training is not an unambiguous match for sensory-only learning.
The controlled study tests a restricted family of models and physical situations, not the general hypothesis.
No shared criterion specifies when partial physical learning becomes sufficient to count as learning physics.
